body.zh-Hant: 費多爾·馮·博克1880年12月3日生於屈斯特林，父親莫里茨是少將。1898年他以少尉身分進入第5近衛步兵團；1913年起以上尉身分在近衛軍團參謀部任職，一戰期間在東、西兩線作戰，並獲頒功勳勳章（Pour le Mérite）。1920年他以中校身分出任第3軍區的參謀長。
body.en: Fedor von Bock was born on 3 December 1880 in Küstrin, the son of Major General Moritz von Bock. In 1898 he entered the 5th Guards Foot Regiment as a lieutenant; from 1913 he served as a captain on the staff of the Guards Corps, took part in the war in both East and West, and won the Pour le Mérite. In 1920 he became chief of staff of Wehrkreis III as a lieutenant colonel.

heading.zh-Hant: 集團司令部與併吞奧地利、蘇台德
heading.en: Group Command 3, Austria and the Sudetenland

body.zh-Hant: 1935年4月，博克出任新設的德累斯頓第3集團司令部總司令。1938年3月他率第8集團軍進入奧地利，同年10月參與進占蘇台德地區；11月1日被任命為柏林第1集團軍群總司令，並同時晉升上將。
body.en: In April 1935 Bock took the supreme command of the newly created Group Command 3 in Dresden. In March 1938 he led the 8th Army into Austria, and in October the march into the Sudetenland. On 1 November 1938 he was appointed commander-in-chief of Army Group 1 in Berlin and promoted to Generaloberst at the same time.

heading.en: Polish campaign and the Western offensive

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9至10月的波蘭戰役中，博克指揮自波美拉尼亞與東普魯士推進的北方集團軍群。北方集團軍群司令部其後改編為B集團軍群，自1939年10月12日起列入編制（聯邦檔案館編制手冊），博克出任B集團軍群總司令；1940年5至6月的西線攻勢中，該集團軍群攻入比利時與荷蘭，博克接受兩國投降。6月14日他在巴黎凱旋門前檢閱國防軍閱兵，7月19日晉升元帥。
body.en: In the Polish campaign of September–October 1939 Bock commanded Army Group North, advancing from Pomerania and East Prussia. The Army Group North staff was then reorganised as Army Group B, listed from 12 October 1939 in the Federal Archives handbook, and he became commander-in-chief of Army Group B; in the Western offensive of May–June 1940 it advanced into Belgium and Holland and he took the surrender of those countries. On 14 June he took the Wehrmacht parade at the Arc de Triomphe in Paris, and on 19 July 1940 he was promoted to Generalfeldmarschall.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年10月博克任德軍占領波蘭地區部隊總司令。1941年6月22日對蘇戰爭開始，他是主攻莫斯科方向的中央集團軍群總司令；莫斯科攻勢受挫後，他於1941年12月離職。1942年1月他接掌南方集團軍群，7月15日因批評在史達林格勒與高加索之間分兵而被解職，此後不再有實際指揮。1945年5月4日他在遭英國低空攻擊重傷後去世。
body.en: In October 1940 Bock became commander of the Wehrmacht troops in the German-occupied part of Poland. When the war against the Soviet Union began on 22 June 1941 he led Army Group Centre, the main weight of the attack towards Moscow; after the failed attack on Moscow he left that command in December 1941. In January 1942 he took over Army Group South and on 15 July 1942 was relieved after criticising the splitting of the group between Stalingrad and the Caucasus; he had no further active employment. He died on 4 May 1945 of injuries from a British low-level air attack.

body.zh-Hant: 賴因哈德·舍爾1863年9月30日生於黑森-拿騷的奧伯恩基興。他1879年以軍校生身分加入帝國海軍，1884至1890年多次參與在西非、東非與南太平洋新殖民地的佔領遠征。他在提爾皮茨手下歷任魚雷試驗委員會參謀、帝國海軍部中央部長，並於1907至1909年任戰艦「埃爾薩斯號」艦長。
body.en: Reinhard Scheer was born on 30 September 1863 at Obernkirchen in Hesse-Nassau. He entered the Imperial Navy as a cadet in 1879 and in 1884–90 took part in several expeditions to take full possession of the newly acquired colonies in West and East Africa and the South Seas. He earned the trust of Grand Admiral Tirpitz as a referent in the Torpedo Trials Commission and head of the central department of the Reich Navy Office, and commanded the battleship Elsass in 1907–09.

heading.zh-Hant: 艦隊司令與斯卡格拉克海戰
heading.en: Fleet command and the Battle of Jutland (Skagerrak)

body.zh-Hant: 舍爾自1913年起任第2、後任第3戰隊司令。一戰爆發後，他被視為唯一能把公海艦隊帶出北海戰略困境的司令官，1916年1月接替重病的艦隊司令波爾。1916年5月31日他率艦隊突入斯卡格拉克海峽，與英國主力艦隊遭遇，這場斯卡格拉克（日德蘭）海戰雙方損失慘重；他此後力主無限制潛艇戰，1917年1月9日該戰爭方式正式宣布。
body.en: From 1913 Scheer was chief of the II and later the III Squadron. After the outbreak of the First World War he was regarded as the only commanding admiral able to lead the High Seas Fleet out of its strategic dead end in the North Sea, and in January 1916 he succeeded the gravely ill fleet chief Hugo von Pohl. The thrust into the Skagerrak on 31 May 1916 brought the main forces of both fleets together; the battle ended with heavy losses on both sides. He then pressed for unrestricted submarine warfare, proclaimed on 9 January 1917.

heading.en: Naval War Command and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1918年8月，舍爾促成設立海戰指導部並任其首長。同年10月他計畫最後一次出擊，但基爾與威廉港水兵的叛變使計畫落空。1918年12月17日他離開海軍。1920年代他以回憶錄與演講為自己的立場辯護，並呼籲重建強大艦隊，1928年11月26日在一次演講旅行途中於馬克特雷德維茨去世。
body.en: In August 1918 Scheer secured the creation of a Naval War Command (Seekriegsleitung), at whose head he stood. In October 1918 he planned a last fleet sortie, which the mutinies of the sailors at Kiel and Wilhelmshaven frustrated. He left the navy on 17 December 1918. In the 1920s he tried through memoirs and lectures to justify his stance and to promote the rebuilding of a strong fleet, and he died on 26 November 1928 at Marktredwitz while on one of these lecture tours.

citations.quote: Aug. 1918 die Bildung einer Seekriegsleitung durch, an deren Spitze er stand.

heading.en: Origins, First World War pilot and the Nazi party

body.zh-Hant: 赫爾曼·戈林1893年1月12日生於上巴伐利亞的羅森海姆。1915年初他轉入飛行部隊，1917年春接掌第27戰鬥機中隊，1918年7月接任著名的里希特霍芬聯隊指揮，戰爭結束時以22次擊落紀錄成為功勳勳章得主。1922年11月他在慕尼黑結識希特勒並加入納粹黨，希特勒隨即將籌建中的衝鋒隊交給他；1923年11月9日啤酒館政變中他身受重傷。
body.en: Hermann Göring was born on 12 January 1893 at Rosenheim in Upper Bavaria. At the beginning of 1915 he was taken into the air service; in spring 1917 he took over Jagdstaffel 27, and in July 1918 he was given command of the famous Richthofen wing, and by the end of the war he was a Pour le Mérite holder with 22 victories. In November 1922 he met Hitler at a rally in Munich and joined the NSDAP; Hitler at once gave him the leadership of the SA then being built up. In the putsch of 9 November 1923 he was severely wounded.

body.zh-Hant: 1928年5月20日，戈林代表納粹黨進入國會，1932年8月30日當選國會議長。1933年1月30日他成為希特勒政府成員，並藉普魯士內政部掌控警察；同年4月任普魯士總理（來源對日期寫法為10或11日），5月5日任航空部長。1935年3月他接掌新成立的空軍總司令職務。
body.en: On 20 May 1928 Göring entered the Reichstag for the NSDAP and on 30 August 1932 he was elected President of the Reichstag. On 30 January 1933 he became a member of the Reich government and, with the Prussian Interior Ministry, took charge of the police. In April 1933 he became Prussian Minister-President (the sources give the 10th or 11th), and on 5 May 1933 Reich Minister of Aviation. In March 1935 he took over the supreme command of the newly founded Luftwaffe.

heading.en: Four-Year Plan, the Battle of Britain and trial

body.zh-Hant: 1936年10月18日戈林被任命為四年計畫全權代表。1940年7月19日他獲授帝國元帥軍階，但同年夏天空軍輸掉不列顛空戰，其地位受到動搖；1942至1943年空軍也未能補給被圍於史達林格勒的部隊。1945年4月23日他請求接掌國家事務，希特勒隨即下令免去他一切職務。1946年10月1日紐倫堡法庭判他死刑，10月15日他在行刑前服毒自殺。
body.en: On 18 October 1936 Göring was appointed Reich Plenipotentiary for the Four-Year Plan. On 19 July 1940 he received the rank of Reichsmarschall, but in the summer of 1940 the Luftwaffe lost the Battle of Britain and his standing was shaken; in 1942–43 the Luftwaffe also failed to supply the troops encircled at Stalingrad. On 23 April 1945 he asked to take over the affairs of state, and Hitler had him removed from all offices. On 1 October 1946 the Nuremberg tribunal sentenced him to death and on 15 October he took poison before the execution.

body.zh-Hant: 阿爾弗雷德·約德爾1890年5月10日生於維爾茨堡，13歲進入巴伐利亞軍校，1910年成為巴伐利亞第4野戰炮兵團的少尉候補生。一戰期間他至1916年12月在西線任炮兵連軍官與連長，兩度負傷。1919年10月1日他正式編入國防軍，1935年7月1日接掌隸屬國防部長的新設「國土防衛」處。
body.en: Alfred Jodl was born on 10 May 1890 at Würzburg and entered the Bavarian cadet corps at 13; in 1910 he was assigned as an ensign to the Bavarian 4th Field Artillery Regiment. In the First World War he served on the Western Front as battery officer and battery commander until December 1916 and was wounded twice. On 1 October 1919 he was finally taken into the Reichswehr, and on 1 July 1935 he took over the new department "Landesverteidigung" under the Reich War Minister.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年大戰爆發前不久，約德爾出任國防軍最高統帥部（OKW）的國防軍指導局長，1940年該局改稱國防軍指導參謀部，他成為希特勒在整體戰爭指導上最親近的顧問。1940年7月19日他越級晉升炮兵上將，1944年2月1日晉升大將。自1942年起，他同時負責自北角到非洲對西方盟軍的陸上戰役行動。
body.en: Shortly before the outbreak of the Second World War in 1939 Jodl took over the Wehrmacht Operations Office (renamed Wehrmachtführungsstab in 1940) at the OKW, and became Hitler's closest adviser on all questions of overall war direction. On 19 July 1940 he was promoted General of Artillery, skipping the rank of lieutenant general, and on 1 February 1944 Generaloberst. From 1942 he also directed the land operations against the Western Allies from the North Cape to Africa.

body.zh-Hant: 1945年5月7日，約德爾在蘭斯代表鄧尼茨簽署德軍無條件投降；5月23日他在弗倫斯堡被俘。紐倫堡國際軍事法庭以破壞和平罪、戰爭罪與危害人類罪判他有罪，1946年10月16日他被絞死。
body.en: On 7 May 1945 Jodl signed the unconditional surrender of the Wehrmacht at Reims as Dönitz's plenipotentiary, and on 23 May 1945 he went into British captivity at Flensburg. The International Military Tribunal at Nuremberg found him guilty of crimes against peace, war crimes and crimes against humanity, and he was hanged on 16 October 1946.

body.zh-Hant: 阿爾弗雷德·馮·鐵必制1849年3月19日生於屈斯特林，1865年加入普魯士海軍，1879至1886年在海軍部負責魚雷事務，1888年以38歲成為最年輕的海軍上校。1892年他任海軍最高司令部參謀長，1896年5月被調為駐遠東的巡洋艦戰隊司令，1897年6月回國接任帝國海軍部國務秘書。
body.en: Alfred von Tirpitz was born on 19 March 1849 in Küstrin and joined the Prussian navy in 1865. In 1879–86 he was the Admiralty's referent for torpedo matters, and in 1888, at 38, he was the youngest Kapitän zur See. From 1892 he was chief of staff at the High Command of the navy; in early May 1896 he was sent to the Far East as chief of the Cruiser Squadron, and in June 1897 he returned to succeed as State Secretary of the Reich Navy Office.

heading.en: Reich Navy Office and the fleet programme

body.zh-Hant: 鐵必制自1897年6月任帝國海軍部國務秘書，1898年成為普魯士國務部長。他推動1898、1900、1908與1912年的艦隊法案，以大型戰艦為核心擴建艦隊；1911年晉升海軍元帥。1905、1906年英國無畏艦出現後，他跟進造艦並於1908年把每年建造的主力艦由三艘增為四艘，引發公開的海軍軍備競賽。
body.en: From June 1897 Tirpitz was State Secretary of the Reich Navy Office, and in 1898 he became a Prussian state minister. He drove through the fleet laws of 1898, 1900, 1908 and 1912, building up a fleet around capital ships, and was promoted Grand Admiral in 1911. His attempt to follow the Royal Navy's change to the Dreadnought type in 1905/06 and, in 1908, to build four instead of three capital ships a year triggered an open arms race.

heading.en: Dismissal in the war and later politics

body.zh-Hant: 一戰爆發後，英國皇家海軍採取遠距封鎖，公海艦隊無力打破，鐵必制的政策失敗已顯而易見。他主張無限制潛艇戰，帝國首相與皇帝出於對美國參戰的顧慮而反對；1916年3月他被解除所有職務（NDB記為16日，LeMO記為15日辭職）。1924至1928年他以德意志民族人民黨代表身分任國會議員，1930年3月6日在埃本豪森去世。
body.en: After the outbreak of war in 1914 the failure of Tirpitz's policy was obvious: the Royal Navy imposed a distant blockade which the High Seas Fleet could not break. He demanded unrestricted submarine warfare, which the Reich Chancellor and the Kaiser rejected for fear of American entry; in March 1916 he was removed from all offices (NDB gives the 16th, LeMO records a resignation on the 15th). In 1924–28 he sat in the Reichstag for the German National People's Party (DNVP), and he died on 6 March 1930 at Ebenhausen.
